episodes.title: Last Day
episodes.summary: Across the globe, strange and unexplainable events begin to unfold. A small-town sheriff senses something bigger is at play.

episodes.title: Crash
episodes.summary: Amid chaos, Aneesha makes a difficult decision for the sake of her family. Trevante, a Navy SEAL, investigates a distress call with his team.

episodes.title: Orion
episodes.summary: Mitsuki takes desperate measures, determined to uncover the truth. Caspar and Jamila discover just how dire their situation is.

episodes.title: The King Is Dead
episodes.summary: Trevante fears the worst until a locator beacon gives him hope. Mitsuki finds an ally in the most unexpected place.

episodes.title: Going Home
episodes.summary: The president of the United States gives an urgent global address in an attempt to prepare the world for what lies ahead.

episodes.title: Home Invasion
episodes.summary: In shock from the president's speech, Aneesha rushes back to her family only to find their safe haven—and their lives—threatened.

episodes.title: Hope
episodes.summary: Mitsuki commandeers a satellite station, hoping to make contact with outer space. Caspar reveals a strange secret he thinks is related to the invasion.

episodes.title: Contact
episodes.summary: Trevante's plane lands, but his journey home is just beginning. Caspar and Jamila brave London's streets, trying to make sense of his secret.

episodes.title: Full of Stars
episodes.summary: Mitsuki is determined to contact the Hoshi 12 before it's too late, as the military detains the Maliks and Caspar takes a risk that may kill him.

episodes.title: First Day
episodes.summary: The world, still reeling from global destruction, faces a new and unforeseen dawn.

episodes.title: Something's Changed
episodes.summary: Mitsuki is taken to an alien ship in the Amazon jungle. Aneesha and her children take refuge with a group called the Movement.

episodes.title: Chasing Ghosts
episodes.summary: At home in Miami, Trevante struggles with returning to day-to-day life. Similarly, Jamila feels an unceasing pull to search for Caspar.

episodes.title: Fireworks
episodes.summary: A game-changing discovery could finally give Earth an advantage. Aneesha finds it difficult to trust the Movement, despite needing their help.

episodes.title: The Tunnel
episodes.summary: Jamila's decision to trek the Channel Tunnel puts the group face-to-face with an even deadlier enemy.

episodes.title: A Voice From the Other Side
episodes.summary: Aneesha, Luke, and the Movement make a plan to locate Sarah. Mitsuki has a devastating encounter with the alien entity.

episodes.title: Pressure Points
episodes.summary: Jamila and the gang reach the hospital and find a surprise. En route to Camp Pierce, the Movement get caught in a savage attack.

episodes.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
episodes.summary: Trevante and Rose investigate a clue that leads them to Ben Shelton's farm. Monty has suspicions about the mission and confides in Jamila.

episodes.title: Cosmic Ocean
episodes.summary: Mitsuki begins experiencing symptoms from her time with the alien entity. Nikhil breaks into the enclosure, setting off global seismic events.

episodes.title: Breakthrough
episodes.summary: A dangerous trip to the alien mothership results in a connection across dimensions.

episodes.title: Old Friends, New Frontiers
episodes.summary: Season finale. A risky operation is humanity's best and last hope.

episodes.title: The Ones We Leave Behind
episodes.summary: Trevante returns to an Earth that's different than the one he left two years ago. Jamila struggles to adapt to this new world.

episodes.title: The Message
episodes.summary: Mysterious alien signals force Mitsuki out of hiding. Nikhil is charged with a task that tests his loyalty.

episodes.title: Infinitas
episodes.summary: Aneesha and Clark's peaceful life is upended by a visit from Trevante and Jamila. Mitsuki and Nikhil search for answers at a portal base.

episodes.title: The Mission
episodes.summary: Jamila and Clark try to find Aneesha, who's begun digging into Infinitas. Trevante, Mitsuki, and Nikhil are hurled into a top-secret WDC mission.

episodes.title: Point of No Return
episodes.summary: Trevante, Mitsuki, and Nikhil must fight their way out of dangerous territory. Aneesha, Clark, and Jamila go on the run with Infinitas.

episodes.title: Marilyn
episodes.summary: Two years ago, when the alien invasion began, Verna and Joel sparked the rise of Infinitas.

episodes.title: Outpost 17
episodes.summary: The team make it to the Dead Zone, only to find a new threat waiting for them.

episodes.title: Life in the Dead Zone
episodes.summary: An extraordinary encounter leads Mitsuki on a harrowing journey—and a crisis of faith.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: Trevante's memories return and reveal a shocking truth. Mitsuki wrestles with doubts about the aliens. The WDC and Infinitas go to war.

episodes.title: The End of the Line
episodes.summary: Season finale. Trevante, Jamila, and Nikhil face the deepest level of alien horror. Aneesha takes on Infinitas. Mitsuki makes a world-altering decision.
